sources.notes: Layer description: January 1,BAS 2026 vintage. Subject envelope query returns no incorporated-place intersection. Supports likely unincorporated Gordon County, not a current jurisdiction letter or clearance of later annexations. County parcel City field is null.

sources.title: Gordon County GIS - Flood Zones flag
sources.notes: Retrieved polygon labeled zone a, Source FEMA-13129C0175D-1. Local 2 m raster intersection flags approximately 110.5 acres/74.1% of retrieved subject polygon. Current FEMA effective date, floodway, elevations and revisions are unverified; both NFHL service routes returned 502. Not regulatory acreage or a development determination.

sources.title: Gordon County GIS - wetland and future-land-use flags
sources.notes: County NWI flag 8 overlaps approximately 5.75 acres, versus 10.66 acres in current public USFWS response on same tax geometry. County copy omits/varies from current federal inventory; use federal map for this screen. Future-land-use flag 9 envelope returns Emerging Mixed Use and Emerging Suburban plan areas; future land use is not actual zoning.

sources.title: USDA NRCS - Soil Data Access spatial query
sources.notes: Regional WKT-envelope query returns 36 SSURGO polygons and component table; all six offered county shapes have approximately 100% raster coverage. Original responses and SQL archived. Dominant component drainage, hydric rating, slopes and hydrologic group are map-unit properties, not measured conditions or engineering clearance.

sources.title: USDA NRCS - Understanding Soil Risks and Hazards
sources.notes: Soil surveys are planning screens with mapping and sampling limitations, not site-specific engineering evaluation or chemical-contamination testing. Use the mapped drainage findings to scope topography, seasonal-water-table, wetlands and geotechnical work.

sources.title: USDA NRCS - hydric soil concept and lists
sources.notes: Hydric lists can include major and minor components and identify potential issues, not exact hydric ground or regulated wetland acreage. Modified agricultural hydrology can still require review. No CWA or NRCS agricultural determination was obtained.

sources.title: Dillon County code - separately published zoning volume
sources.notes: Section 44-2 incorporates the February 28, 2007 zoning ordinance, a separate volume, and amendments. Online general code is only codified through April 22, 2015/updated August 31, 2017. No current county use table located. City of Dillon zoning is a different jurisdiction and is not applied to Baker parcels.

sources.title: City of Calhoun - June 8, 2026 council minutes
sources.notes: Page 13 records approval extending data-center moratorium to January 25, 2027. Not shown to govern subject; relevant only to a proven municipal/annexation branch. Nearby municipal service or annexation must be separately investigated; county moratorium remains the likely primary branch.

sources.title: Gordon County - July 7, 2026 agenda
sources.notes: Item XI.11 calls for consideration of moratorium-extension resolutions. The July 8 adopted-action notice supplies the January 29, 2027 date; agenda alone is not proof of adoption. Signed resolution definitions/exceptions remain missing.
